categories.main_business_segments: Donglai Coating Technology primarily operates in high-performance coatings based on advanced petrochemical new materials. Its main business segments include automotive aftermarket repair coatings, new car interior and exterior trim coatings, new car body coatings, and coatings for 3C consumer electronics. The company also provides professional on-site color matching services and technical support related to these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on polymer material research, continuous optimization of coating formulations, long-term accumulation of manufacturing processes, and digital color matching technologies. It holds numerous patents related to environmentally friendly water-based coatings, fast-drying intermediates, high-adhesion clear coats, and specialized coatings for various automotive substrates. Production involves physical processes such as mixing, high-speed dispersion, grinding, inspection, and packaging, with a just-in-time production model based on orders and inventory management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive OEMs, authorized 4S dealerships, large and medium-sized auto repair shops, and suppliers in the 3C consumer electronics industry. The company serves major automotive brands including BMW, BYD, Audi, Volkswagen, and various new energy vehicle manufacturers. Its products are used in automotive manufacturing lines, aftermarket repair, and consumer electronics protective coatings.
categories.geographic_coverage: Donglai Technology operates primarily in China with significant market presence in key regions such as Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest China. The company has also expanded overseas markets, with overseas sales accounting for approximately 14% of total revenue, including supply to Russia and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and direct sales of automotive and electronics coatings. It collaborates closely with upstream chemical raw material suppliers for joint R&D and supplies finished coating products downstream to OEMs, dealerships, and repair shops.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous investment in R&D to develop high-performance, environmentally friendly water-based coatings and compact coating processes. The company emphasizes innovation in green technologies, digital color matching systems, and expanding OEM certifications. It plans to build a flexible manufacturing base with a focus on intelligent production lines and enhanced customer value chain integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of coating products and related consumables to automotive OEMs, dealerships, and electronics manufacturers. The company also earns income from technical services such as on-site color matching, custom color development, and efficiency optimization, which are bundled with product sales without separate charges.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Donglai Technology is the leading Chinese brand in the automotive aftermarket repair coatings sector, competing with major international players such as PPG, BASF, Axalta, AkzoNobel, and Sherwin-Williams. It holds a unique position as the only Chinese brand among the top certified suppliers to mainstream automotive OEMs, with strong differentiation in technology and service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 519 million, a 31.83% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 51.67 million, a 140.66% increase. Total assets grew by 26.59% to RMB 1.57 billion. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding market share and increased R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Donglai Technology emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies, environmentally friendly water-based coatings, and comprehensive technical services including digital color matching and rapid on-site support. Its products offer superior durability, aesthetic quality, and environmental compliance, meeting stringent OEM certifications. The company’s integrated product-service model and strong OEM relationships provide significant competitive advantages and customer loyalty.
